headline: Three of your page titles still carry Squarespace starter names: General 6 on the drive-thru and About pages, and Contact 1 on Contact.
summary: Jared's Real Food is a regenerative, no-till farm in Lakeside, established in 2011, with a drive-thru farm stand at 11106 Moreno Ave and CSA boxes delivered around East County. The site posts a fresh produce list every week, and Google Maps has a solid card with the address, phone, website, an opening time, and photos. The leftover is in the page titles, the names that show on a browser tab and often in search results: the drive-thru and About pages are titled General 6, and the Contact page is titled Contact 1.

signals.note: You show up on Google Maps as Jared's Real Food, Farm, 11106 Moreno Ave, Lakeside, with jaredsrealfood.com, (619) 403-4639, an opening time of 2:30 PM, photos, and reviews.
signals.next: A short thank you under new reviews keeps the card feeling lived in.

signals.note: jaredsrealfoodsd@gmail.com is linked on every page, and the Contact page has a message form. The site does not print a phone number. Google lists (619) 403-4639.
signals.next: Add the phone number to the Contact page so it matches Google.

signals.note: Google shows an opening time of 2:30 PM for the stand. The drive-thru page says when the stand is back open but does not print a time.
signals.next: Add the stand's open window to the drive-thru page, the same as on Google.

signals.note: Google has photos on your card, and the site has a Gallery page.
signals.next: Add a couple of stand photos to Google when the season turns.

signals.note: The site is current, with a weekly produce list and prices, CSA info, and a newsletter signup. The drive-thru and About page titles read General 6, the Contact page title reads Contact 1, and the YouTube icon opens a YouTube search results page instead of a channel.
signals.next: Rename those three page titles, and point the YouTube icon at your channel or remove it.

signals.note: The address on the Location and Contact pages matches Google, and Google links straight to jaredsrealfood.com.
signals.next: Keep the name and address exactly like this on every listing.
